migration_impact: No Alembic migration; only the isolated chatbi_benchmark_v21 schema is created or reset.
license_impact: None; generated SQL, Python and synthetic data are project-owned.
rollback: Stop queries using the benchmark datasource, then drop only the isolated chatbi_benchmark_v21 schema after explicit approval.

cases.name: simple_monthly
cases.query: SELECT net_sales FROM "chatbi_benchmark_v21".agg_monthly_sales WHERE tenant_id=1 AND month_start=date '2025-07-01'

cases.name: standard_region
cases.query:
SELECT region_id, round(sum(net_amount-refund_amount)::numeric,2) AS value
            FROM "chatbi_benchmark_v21".fact_sales WHERE tenant_id=1 AND order_date>=date '2025-01-01' AND order_date<date '2026-01-01'
            GROUP BY region_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

cases.name: complex_product
cases.query:
SELECT p.category, round(sum(f.net_amount-f.refund_amount)::numeric,2) AS value
            FROM "chatbi_benchmark_v21".fact_sales f JOIN "chatbi_benchmark_v21".dim_product p ON p.product_id=f.product_id
            WHERE f.tenant_id=1 AND f.order_date>=date '2025-01-01' AND f.order_date<date '2026-01-01'
            GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY value DESC

cases.name: receivable_aging
cases.query:
SELECT aging_bucket, sum(outstanding_amount) FROM "chatbi_benchmark_v21".agg_receivable_aging
            WHERE tenant_id=1 GROUP BY aging_bucket ORDER BY aging_bucket
